description: Returns the latest items from a public RSS 2.0 or Atom feed as JSON: title, link, published date, summary (500 chars max) and guid for each item, plus feed title and link. Inputs: ?url= (public http/https feed URL, required), ?limit= (1-50, default 10). Caps: 3 MB feed read, 50 items max, 15 s per call. Private and local addresses are refused. Feeds that are HTML pages, PDFs or binary files return ok:false with a plain reason. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/rss-latest.
name: rss-latest
